title: WOKE BRANDS
summary: hbomberguy examines whether a product can be truly progressive, looking at brands that adopt social causes in their marketing, with the Gillette ad as a prompt. It argues the behavior is driven by profit, not politics.
why: Cited in threads on corporate politics, outrage and branding as an explanation of how companies use controversy and social stances for profit.

quote.text: a very poignant discussion of the problematic underpinnings of brands adopting a particular aspect of a "personality
